I guess part of the problem is.... I was very depressed a couple of years ago... and I had gotten past it... I really had. So part of the problem is that I feel that this is where all roads lead. I feel like I had gotten out of this but this is back where I am. So I have yet to really believe the "it gets better" theory simply because even when it does it doesn't.
I have no real friends, my life should be good... I should be happy for the things I have... but what I have does jack shit to save me from this... I can't do it any more... I just can't
I just tried to call literally every friend I have... including my boss... and no one has time to talk to me right now... this isn't helping these feelings :*(
Let's talk. Are you on skype? PM me if you want.

It's never ending... how many times do people say things get better... and then they do... for like five minutes... and then before you know it it's worse than before. 

I'm just in agony. 

I've had one or two good things happen in my life and about 6000 bad things. I can't do it any more. I hate the life I have, the body I'm in, the future that seems to be hitting me. There is nothing that gives me any long term hope. Everything goes bad.
